evidence.quoted_text:
if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', target):
        raise ValueError('target must be a full commit SHA')
evidence.reason: The no-tag path validates only the 40-character lowercase-hex shape. An annotated tag object ID satisfies that regex, and Git peels it for the ancestry/tree/show and checkout operations. The `cat-file -t` type check at line 796 runs only when `tag` is supplied, so an annotated tag object can pass as `--sha` without being a commit. Requiring `git cat-file -t target` to be `commit` before ancestry is the smallest compatible fix.
